dedupe_keys.name: santander historical daily sea level observations

description: The Santander sea-level deposit contains rescued daily averages from three historical instruments at two harbour locations in northern Spain. The University of the Balearic Islands team digitised logbooks, checked values and connected the records using levelling information. BODC provides text data and documentation without access restrictions; its repository-supplied DataCite description states CC-BY-4.0. The series can test seasonal coastal water-level simulations and place modern port or flood-defence conditions within a longer observational baseline. It complements recent gauges with nineteenth-century measurements. Its coverage is inconsistent across current metadata: the BODC inventory title and abstract end in 1924, while the structured period and DataCite description extend to December 1928. Both endpoints are retained pending file-level verification. The article also identifies remaining uncertainty in long-term datum reliability. Daily averages cannot represent instantaneous storm-surge maxima, and an apparent connection to modern observations should not be treated as proof of a fully homogeneous trend record.
